lines.say: The Romanian deadlift. What does it really work?
Unlike a normal deadlift, you never put the bar on the floor. You start standing, and push your hips back.
That stretches your hamstrings and glutes while they hold the weight. Your back muscles keep you straight.
Training muscles in a long, stretched position looks great for growth in studies.
The biggest mistake: rounding your back to reach the floor. You only go as low as your hips allow.
So: knees soft, bar close to your legs, hips back, and stop when your back wants to round.
